decision: R2294: original 299-335 and 389-426 are complete public HWND wrappers. Both underscored WND navigation algorithms remain original. The Win16 public calls reach wow_native_GetNextDlgTabItem/GroupItem, whose discovery wrappers call USER32 and publish native HWND identity. Reintroducing same names collides with those mapped providers; the original group entry also lacks the WINAPI convention of the x86 binding. No independent helper in either removed block. Keep public discovery boundary pending owner.
